description: Baseline setup: added calendar benchmark harness (median over repeated multi-year runs), autoresearch scripts, and calendar test checks.
Optimize MassManager.calcRank by removing repeated date-fns parsing and looped case matching; use direct yyyy-MM-dd substring checks for Advent rank override.
Replace date-fns format/parse in lib/utils.ts with specialized yyyy-MM-dd helpers to avoid heavy per-call parsing/formatting overhead.
Precompute and cache MassManager filtered collections (tempora/sancti classes, Easter/advent/ember subsets) to eliminate repeated full-array filters during calendar conflict resolution.
Avoid Date object parsing in insertSanctiDays (direct yyyy-MM-dd slicing) and replace addDays loop in buildEmptyCalendar with in-place native date increment.
Verification rerun of previous change for noise check; result slightly slower than the kept run, so recorded as discard for tracking only.
Tried sharing ConcurrencyResolver/rule instances across Calendar builds to reduce object allocation; no measurable improvement over current best.
